xmin) * inv_h;\n        float fy = (p.y - ymin) * inv_h;\n        float fz = (p.z - zmin) * inv_h;\n        if (fx < 0.0f || fy < 0.0f || fz < 0.0f || fx >= nx - 1.001f || fy >= ny - 1.001f || fz >= nz - 1.001f) {\n            // Outside padded SDF grid: compute safe lower-bound distance to surf_a AABB!\n            float dx = std::max({0.0f, bbox_min_surf.x - p.x, p.x - bbox_max_surf.x});\n            float dy = std::max({0.0f, bbox_min_surf.y - p.y, p.y - bbox_max_surf.y});\n            float dz = std::max({0.0f, bbox_min_surf.z - p.z, p.z - bbox_max_surf.z});\n            return std::sqrt(dx*dx + dy*dy + dz*dz);\n        }\n        int i = (int)fx, j = (int)fy, k = (int)fz;\n        float tx = fx - i, ty = fy - j, tz = fz - k;\n        size_t base = ((size_t)i * ny + j) * nz + k;\n        size_t sy = nz, sx = (size_t)ny * nz;\n        float c000 = data[base];\n        float c001 = data[base + 1];\n        float c010 = data[base + sy];\n        float c011 = data[base + sy + 1];\n        float c100 = data[base + sx];\n        float c101 = data[base + sx + 1];\n        float c110 = data[base + sx + sy];\n        float c111 = data[base + sx + sy + 1];\n        float c00 = c000 + tx*(c100 - c000);\n        float c01 = c001 + tx*(c101 - c001);\n        float c10 = c010 + tx*(c110 - c010);\n        float c11 = c011 + tx*(c111 - c011);\n        float c0 = c00 + ty*(c10 - c00);\n        float c1 = c01 + ty*(c11 - c01);\n        return c0 + tz*(c1 - c0);\n    }\n\n    inline float queryGrad(const Vec3& p, Vec3& grad) const {\n        float fx = (p.x - xmin) * inv_h;\n        float fy = (p.y - ymin) * inv_h;\n        float fz = (p.z - zmin) * inv_h;\n        if (fx < 1.0f || fy < 1.0f || fz < 1.0f || fx >= nx - 2.001f || fy >= ny - 2.001f || fz >= nz - 2.001f) {\n            grad = Vec3(0, 0, 0);\n            return query(p);\n        }\n        int i = (int)fx, j = (int)fy, k = (int)fz;\n        float tx = fx - i, ty = fy - j, tz = fz - k;\n        size_t base = ((size_t)i * ny + j) * nz + k;\n        size_t sy = nz, sx = (size_t)ny * nz;\n        float c000 = data[base],          c001 = data[base + 1];\n        float c010 = data[base + sy],     c011 = data[base + sy + 1];\n        float c100 = data[base + sx],     c101 = data[base + sx + 1];\n        float c110 = data[base + sx + sy],c111 = data[base + sx + sy + 1];\n\n        float d00 = c100 - c000, d01 = c101 - c001, d10 = c110 - c010, d11 = c111 - c011;\n        float c00 = c000 + tx*d00, c01 = c001 + tx*d01, c10 = c010 + tx*d10, c11 = c011 + tx*d11;\n        float c0 = c00 + ty*(c10 - c00), c1 = c01 + ty*(c11 - c01);\n        float val = c0 + tz*(c1 - c0);\n\n        float gx = ((1.0f - ty)*d00 + ty*d10)*(1.0f - tz) + ((1.0f - ty)*d01 + ty*d11)*tz;\n        float gy = (c10 - c00)*(1.0f - tz) + (c11 - c01)*tz;\n        float gz = c1 - c0;\n        grad = Vec3(gx * inv_h, gy * inv_h, gz * inv_h);\n        float gn = grad.norm();\n        if (gn > 1e-6f) grad = grad * (1.0f / gn);\n        return val;\n    }\n} sdf;\n\n// 1D exact parabola lower envelope for continuous seeds (u_m, w_m) where u_m is sorted ascending!\n// Minimizes (q - u_m)^2 + w_m for query coordinates q_i = q0 + i * h\nvoid envelope1D(const std::vector<float>& u, const std::vector<float>& w, const std::vector<int>& id,\n                float q0, float h, int n_out, std::vector<int>& out_id) {\n    int m = (int)u.size();\n    if (m == 0) {\n        std::fill(out_id.begin(), out_id.end(), -1);\n        return;\n    }\n    // Filter duplicate/very close u: keep minimum w\n    std::vector<int> hull;\n    std::vector<float> z(m + 1);\n    hull.reserve(m);\n    for (int i = 0; i < m; ++i) {\n        if (!hull.empty() && std::abs(u[i] - u[hull.back()]) < 1e-6f) {\n            if (w[i] < w[hull.back()]) {\n                hull.back() = i;\n                // recompute intersection with previous if needed\n                while (hull.size() >= 2) {\n                    int a = hull[hull.size() - 2];\n                    int b = hull.back();\n                    float inter = ((w[b] + u[b]*u[b]) - (w[a] + u[a]*u[a])) / (2.0f * (u[b] - u[a]));\n                    if (hull.size() >= 3 && inter <= z[hull.size() - 2]) {\n                        hull.erase(hull.end() - 2);\n                    } else {\n                        z[hull.size() - 1] = inter;\n                        break;\n                    }\n                }\n                if (hull.size() == 1) z[0] = -1e30f;\n            }\n            continue;\n        }\n        while (hull.size() >= 1) {\n            int a = hull.back();\n            float inter = ((w[i] + u[i]*u[i]) - (w[a] + u[a]*u[a])) / (2.0f * (u[i] - u[a]));\n            if (hull.size() >= 2 && inter <= z[hull.size() - 1]) {\n                hull.pop_back();\n            } else {\n                z[hull.size()] = inter;\n                break;\n            }\n        }\n        if (hull.empty()) z[0] = -1e30f;\n        hull.push_back(i);\n    }\n    z[hull.size()] = 1e30f;\n    int k = 0;\n    int hs = (int)hull.size();\n    for (int qi = 0; qi < n_out; ++qi) {\n        float q = q0 + qi * h;\n        while (k + 1 < hs && z[k + 1] < q) ++k;\n        out_id[qi] = id[hull[k]];\n    }\n}\n\nfloat distToCenterlineA(const Vec3& p) {\n    float best2 = 1e30f;\n    for (size_t i = 0; i + 1 < cl_a.size(); ++i) {\n        Vec3 ab = cl_a[i+1] - cl_a[i];\n        float len2 = ab.norm2();\n        float t = (len2 > 1e-12f) ? (p - cl_a[i]).dot(ab) / len2 : 0.0f;\n        t = std::max(0.0f, std::min(1.0f, t));\n        Vec3 proj = cl_a[i] + ab * t;\n        float d2 = (p - proj).norm2();\n        if (d2 < best2) best2 = d2;\n    }\n    return std::sqrt(best2);\n}\n\nvoid buildSDF() {\n    auto t0 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    Vec3 bmin(1e30f, 1e30f, 1e30f), bmax(-1e30f, -1e30f, -1e30f);\n    for (const auto& p : surf_a) {\n        bmin.x = std::min(bmin.x, p.x); bmin.y = std::min(bmin.y, p.y); bmin.z = std::min(bmin.z, p.z);\n        bmax.x = std::max(bmax.x, p.x); bmax.y = std::max(bmax.y, p.y); bmax.z = std::max(bmax.z, p.z);\n    }\n    sdf.bbox_min_surf = bmin;\n    sdf.bbox_max_surf = bmax;\n    float pad = 0.20f;\n    sdf.h = 0.004f;\n    sdf.inv_h = 1.0f / sdf.h;\n    sdf.xmin = bmin.x - pad;\n    sdf.ymin = bmin.y - pad;\n    sdf.zmin = bmin.z - pad;\n    sdf.nx = (int)std::ceil((bmax.x + pad - sdf.xmin) * sdf.inv_h) + 1;\n    sdf.ny = (int)std::ceil((bmax.y + pad - sdf.ymin) * sdf.inv_h) + 1;\n    sdf.nz = (int)std::ceil((bmax.z + pad - sdf.zmin) * sdf.inv_h) + 1;\n    size_t total = (size_t)sdf.nx * sdf.ny * sdf.nz;\n    std::cout << \"Building SDF grid: \" << sdf.nx << \" x \" << sdf.ny << \" x \" << sdf.nz\n              << \" (\" << (total * 4.0 / (1024*1024)) << \" MB)...\" << std::endl;\n\n    std::vector<int> voronoi(total, -1);\n\n    // Bin seeds into (j, k) rows first, sorted by x!\n    std::vector<std::vector<int>> row_seeds((size_t)sdf.ny * sdf.nz);\n    for (int idx = 0; idx < (int)surf_a.size(); ++idx) {\n        int j = std::clamp((int)std::round((surf_a[idx].y - sdf.ymin) * sdf.inv_h), 0, sdf.ny - 1);\n        int k = std::clamp((int)std::round((surf_a[idx].z - sdf.zmin) * sdf.inv_h), 0, sdf.nz - 1);\n        row_seeds[(size_t)j * sdf.nz + k].push_back(idx);\n    }\n\n    // Pass 1: X\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        std::vector<float> u, w;\n        std::vector<int> ids, out(sdf.nx);\n        #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n        for (int jk = 0; jk < sdf.ny * sdf.nz; ++jk) {\n            auto& seeds = row_seeds[jk];\n            if (seeds.empty()) continue;\n            std::sort(seeds.begin(), seeds.end(), [&](int a, int b){ return surf_a[a].x < surf_a[b].x; });\n            int j = jk / sdf.nz, k = jk % sdf.nz;\n            float y = sdf.ymin + j * sdf.h;\n            float z = sdf.zmin + k * sdf.h;\n            u.resize(seeds.size()); w.resize(seeds.size()); ids.resize(seeds.size());\n            for (size_t s = 0; s < seeds.size(); ++s) {\n                int id = seeds[s];\n                u[s] = surf_a[id].x;\n                float dy = y - surf_a[id].y, dz = z - surf_a[id].z;\n                w[s] = dy*dy + dz*dz;\n                ids[s] = id;\n            }\n            envelope1D(u, w, ids, sdf.xmin, sdf.h, sdf.nx, out);\n            for (int i = 0; i < sdf.nx; ++i) {\n                voronoi[sdf.idx(i, j, k)] = out[i];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    row_seeds.clear(); row_seeds.shrink_to_fit();\n\n    // Pass 2: Y\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        std::vector<int> cand;\n        std::vector<float> u, w;\n        std::vector<int> ids, out(sdf.ny);\n        #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n        for (int ik = 0; ik < sdf.nx * sdf.nz; ++ik) {\n            int i = ik / sdf.nz, k = ik % sdf.nz;\n            float x = sdf.xmin + i * sdf.h;\n            float z = sdf.zmin + k * sdf.h;\n            cand.clear();\n            for (int j = 0; j < sdf.ny; ++j) {\n                int id = voronoi[sdf.idx(i, j, k)];\n                if (id >= 0) cand.push_back(id);\n            }\n            if (cand.empty()) continue;\n            std::sort(cand.begin(), cand.end(), [&](int a, int b){ return surf_a[a].y < surf_a[b].y; });\n            u.resize(cand.size()); w.resize(cand.size()); ids.resize(cand.size());\n            for (size_t s = 0; s < cand.size(); ++s) {\n                int id = cand[s];\n                u[s] = surf_a[id].y;\n                float dx = x - surf_a[id].x, dz = z - surf_a[id].z;\n                w[s] = dx*dx + dz*dz;\n                ids[s] = id;\n            }\n            envelope1D(u, w, ids, sdf.ymin, sdf.h, sdf.ny, out);\n            for (int j = 0; j < sdf.ny; ++j) {\n                voronoi[sdf.idx(i, j, k)] = out[j];\n            }\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Pass 3: Z + compute signed distance!\n    sdf.data.resize(total);\n    #pragma omp parallel\n    {\n        std::vector<int> cand;\n        std::vector<float> u, w;\n        std::vector<int> ids, out(sdf.nz);\n        #pragma omp for schedule(dynamic, 64)\n        for (int ij = 0; ij < sdf.nx * sdf.ny; ++ij) {\n            int i = ij / sdf.ny, j = ij % sdf.ny;\n            float x = sdf.xmin + i * sdf.h;\n            float y = sdf.ymin + j * sdf.h;\n            cand.clear();\n            for (int k = 0; k < sdf.nz; ++k) {\n                int id = voronoi[sdf.idx(i, j, k)];\n                if (id >= 0) cand.push_back(id);\n            }\n            u.resize(cand.size()); w.resize(cand.size()); ids.resize(cand.size());\n            for (size_t s = 0; s < cand.size(); ++s) {\n                int id = cand[s];\n                u[s] = surf_a[id].z;\n                float dx = x - surf_a[id].x, dy = y - surf_a[id].y;\n                w[s] = dx*dx + dy*dy;\n                ids[s] = id;\n            }\n            envelope1D(u, w, ids, sdf.zmin, sdf.h, sdf.nz, out);\n            for (int k = 0; k < sdf.nz; ++k) {\n                int id = out[k];\n                float z = sdf.zmin + k * sdf.h;\n                Vec3 g(x, y, z);\n                Vec3 diff = g - surf_a[id];\n                float d = diff.norm();\n                float sign = 1.0f;\n                if (d < 0.12f) {\n                    float dot_in = diff.dot(norm_a_in[id]);\n                    if (dot_in > 0.0002f) {\n                        // Also verify inside tube envelope\n                        if ((g - cl_a.front()).dot(out0_a) <= 0.002f &&\n                            (g - cl_a.back()).dot(out1_a) <= 0.002f &&\n                            distToCenterlineA(g) < 0.110f) {\n                            sign = -1.0f;\n                        }\n                    }\n                }\n                sdf.data[sdf.idx(i, j, k)] = sign * d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    auto t1 = std::chrono::high_resolution_clock::now();\n    std::cout << \"SDF built in \" << std::chrono::duration<double>(t1 - t0).count() << \" s.\" << std::endl;\n}\n\n// Fast clearance / collision check!\n// Returns minimum SDF if >= threshold, else returns early value < threshold!\nfloat checkClearance(const Pose& pose, float threshold, bool fine = true) {\n    // Workspace check on handle (reference point pose.p):\n    // Workspace is [-0.8, 3.2]^3; keep comfortable margin [-0.72, 3.12]^3\n    if (pose.p.x < -0.72f || pose.p.y < -0.72f || pose.p.z < -0.72f ||\n        pose.p.x >  3.12f || pose.p.y >  3.12f || pose.p.z >  3.12f) {\n        return -1.0f;\n    }\n    float R[9];\n    pose.q.toMat(R);\n\n    float min_d = 1e30f;\n    float d_centers[66];\n\n    // Pass 0: check 66 centerline points!\n    for (int b = 0; b < 66; ++b) {\n        Vec3 wc = xform(R, pose.p, buckets[b].center);\n        float d = sdf.query(wc);\n        d_centers[b] = d;\n        // On interior buckets (2..63), tube cross section has radius >= 0.102m in all directions around center!\n        if (b >= 2 && b <= 63 && d < 0.096f + threshold) {\n            return d - 0.103f; // Guaranteed < threshold!\n        }\n        // Lower bound on this bucket is d - r_max_fine\n        if (d - buckets[b].r_max_fine < min_d) {\n            // Will need bucket check if d <= r_max_fine + threshold (or if computing exact min_d)\n        } else {\n            // Even without checking points, this bucket is >= min_d\n        }\n    }\n\n    // Pass 1: for any bucket where d_centers[b] <= r_max_fine + threshold (or to get accurate min_d < 0.06f)\n    float active_band = std::max(threshold, 0.05f);\n    bool any_active = false;\n    for (int b = 0; b < 66; ++b) {\n        if (d_centers[b] <= buckets[b].r_max_fine + active_band) {\n            any_active = true;\n            for (const auto& pt : buckets[b].coarse_pts) {\n                float d = sdf.query(xform(R, pose.p, pt));\n                if (d < threshold) return d;\n                if (d < min_d) min_d = d;\n            }\n        } else {\n            float lb = d_centers[b] - buckets[b].r_max_fine;\n            if (lb < min_d) min_d = lb;\n        }\n    }\n    if (!fine || !any_active) return min_d;\n\n    // Pass 2: fine check only on buckets where d_centers[b] <= r_max_fine + std::min(min_d, active_band)\n    for (int b = 0; b < 66; ++b) {\n        if (d_centers[b] <= buckets[b].r_max_fine + std::max(threshold + 0.008f, std::min(min_d, 0.035f))) {\n            for (const auto& pt : buckets[b].fine_pts) {\n                float d = sdf.query(xform(R, pose.p, pt));\n                if (d < threshold) return d;\n                if (d < min_d) min_d = d;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n    return min_d;\n}\n\n// Retract/push a pose away from tube_a using SDF gradients!\n// Pushes any surface points closer than target_margin outward!\nbool retractPose(Pose& pose, float target_margin, int max_iters = 6) {\n    for (int it = 0; it < max_iters; ++it) {\n        if (pose.p.x < -0.72f || pose.p.y < -0.72f || pose.p.z < -0.72f ||\n            pose.p.x >  3.12f || pose.p.y >  3.12f || pose.p.z >  3.12f) {\n            return false;\n        }\n        float R[9];\n        pose.q.toMat(R);\n        Vec3 F(0,0,0), tau(0,0,0);\n        float min_d = 1e30f;\n        int n_act = 0;\n        float sense = target_margin + 0.012f;\n\n        for (int b = 0; b < 66; ++b) {\n            Vec3 wc = xform(R, pose.p, buckets[b].center);\n            float dc = sdf.query(wc);\n            if (dc > buckets[b].r_max_coarse + sense) {\n                min_d = std::min(min_d, dc - buckets[b].r_max_coarse);\n                continue;\n            }\n            for (const auto& pt : buckets[b].coarse_pts) {\n                Vec3 rel(R[0]*pt.x + R[1]*pt.y + R[2]*pt.z,\n                         R[3]*pt.x + R[4]*pt.y + R[5]*pt.z,\n                         R[6]*pt.x + R[7]*pt.y + R[8]*pt.z);\n                Vec3 wp = pose.p + rel;\n                Vec3 g;\n                float d = sdf.queryGrad(wp, g);\n                if (d < min_d) min_d = d;\n                if (d < sense && g.norm2() > 0.5f) {\n                    float w = (sense - d);\n                    F = F + g * w;\n                    tau = tau + rel.cross(g * w);\n                    n_act++;\n                }\n            }\n        }\n        if (min_d >= target_margin) {\n            // Double check with fine points!\n            if (checkClearance(pose, target_margin, true) >= target_margin) return true;\n        }\n        if (n_act == 0) break;\n        F = F * (1.0f / n_act);\n        tau = tau * (1.0f / n_act);\n        float fn = F.norm();\n        float tn = tau.norm();\n        float step_need = std::max(0.004f, std::min(0.035f, (target_margin - min_d) + 0.004f));\n        if (fn > 1e-6f || tn > 1e-6f) {\n            // Combine linear and rotational push (characteristic radius ~ 0.6m)\n            float denom = fn*fn + 0.35f * tn*tn + 1e-9f;\n            float alpha = step_need / std::sqrt(denom);\n            Vec3 dp = F * alpha;\n            Vec3 dw = tau * (0.35f * alpha);\n            if (dp.norm() > 0.035f) dp = dp * (0.035f / dp.norm());\n            if (dw.norm() > 0.07f)  dw = dw * (0.07f / dw.norm());\n            pose.p = pose.p + dp;\n            pose.q = (Quat::fromAxisAngle(dw) * pose.q).unit();\n        } else {\n            break;\n        }\n    }\n    return checkClearance(pose, target_margin, true) >= target_margin;\n}\n\n// Check continuous edge validity between p0 and p1\nbool edgeValid(const Pose& a, const Pose& b, float margin, bool check_both_profiles = false) {\n    float dp = (b.p - a.p).norm();\n    float dq = quatAngleDist(a.q, b.q);\n    int steps = std::max(2, (int)std::ceil(std::max(dp / 0.012f, dq / 0.015f)));\n    for (int s = 1; s <= steps; ++s) {\n        float t = (float)s / steps;\n        Pose m;\n        m.p = a.p + (b.p - a.p) * t;\n        m.q = quatSlerp(a.q, b.q, t);\n        if (checkClearance(m, margin, true) < margin) return false;\n    }\n    if (check_both_profiles && (dp > 1e-5f && dq > 1e-5f)) {\n        // Also check independent speed limiter profile (v=0.1 m/s, w=0.1 rad/s)!\n        float t_lin = dp / 0.1f;\n        float t_ang = dq / 0.1f;\n        float t_tot = std::max(t_lin, t_ang);\n        for (int s = 1; s < steps; ++s) {\n            float tau = ((float)s / steps) * t_tot;\n            float sl = std::min(1.0f, tau / t_lin);\n            float sa = std::min(1.0f, tau / t_ang);\n            if (std::abs(sl -
